subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker until Anthropic signed-thinking replay prevention lands, or should maintainers close it in favor of the narrower native Anthropic tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 is reviewed?
rationale: The recovery fixes are present on main, but the remaining prevention path changes provider replay policy and has multiple related open PRs; automation should not choose the canonical scope or replay semantics for maintainers.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make narrower issue canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a handoff that makes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the remaining canonical tracker.

options.title: Defer prevention policy
options.body: Treat the landed recovery slices as sufficient for now and leave prevention to later provider replay review, accepting continued one-shot recovery dependence.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion and is the strongest available owner signal for the Anthropic thinking replay-policy tradeoff.
